messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Evidence handoff for BYOK/KMS + SSO + audit log requests

Team — forwarding the incoming compliance asks from Medix Health so we can align on deliverables and owner. High level from their thread: they need an evidence package to support a procurement review that covers BYOK/KMS integration, SSO configuration (SAML metadata + IdP cert rotation), and a sample of audit logs showing retention + exportability.

Key asks I captured:
- BYOK: key lifecycle diagram + KMS audit evidence (rotation, envelope keys, import key ID)
- SSO: SAML metadata, cert rotation cadence, and test account steps
- Audit logs: sample export (30 days), schema, and retention policy enforcement (delete/keep rules)

Attachment: evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx — quick checklist I sketched. Please review and add owners in the spreadsheet.

Can we get owners and an estimated delivery for a first-pass evidence pack by EOD next Tuesday (2027-08-03)? This is timeboxed by their procurement window.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff for BYOK/KMS + SSO + audit log requests

Evelyn — thanks for pulling this together. A few technical clarifications from my side before we commit timelines: 

1) BYOK scope: do they require a formal HSM-backed import path (i.e., wrapped/imported keys) or will KMS-managed keys with customer access controls suffice? The evidence we provide differs (HSM attestation vs. KMS audit events).
2) Audit logs: what retention windows do they want plotted? We currently retain detailed agent logs for 90 days and aggregated indexes for 1 year; export tooling can produce JSON/CSV by request. Need to confirm format preference (Parquet or JSON preferred by most auditors).
3) SSO: we can share SAML metadata and rotation cadence; for cert rotation we can also provide a short runbook. If they want proof of rotation events we can extract a rotation event record from the audit stream — will need an exact time range.

I can own the logs export and SSO runbook; will need access to the HubSpot record to capture mutual action items.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Security Engineer
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff for BYOK/KMS + SSO + audit log requests

Agree with Neha. A couple product notes so Medix gets realistic expectations: 
- BYOK: We currently support KMS integrations in two modes: tenant-managed KMS (customer provides key material via import or we wrap it) and Redwood-managed KMS with customer key policies. Full HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2 level X) is only available for Private deployments — need to call that out if they expect HSM certs.
- Audit exports: generating a 30-day sample is straightforward; producing a stream that mirrors our internal schema for all API calls will require a brief data-mapping doc; I can produce that in 24 hours.
- Timeline: if Neha takes logs and I draft the KMS/keyflow diagram, we can have a first-pass evidence pack for review by 2027-08-03 EOD as requested.

I'll add a short caveat paragraph about HSM vs. KMS managed keys for clarity.

— Priyom
Product Manager, Platforms
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@medixhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@medixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Evidence handoff for BYOK/KMS + SSO + audit log requests

Thanks, Evelyn and team. A few clarifications from Medix: 
- We prefer Parquet exports for large-volume audit review, but JSON is acceptable for smaller samples. Parquet for the 30-day sample would be ideal.
- BYOK: we do not require HSM attestation for this procurement stage; a clear diagram of key wrapping/import, rotation auditing, and proof that keys are customer-scoped is sufficient.
- SSO: please include a sample SAML assertion and the cert rotation event record if possible.

Our procurement window closes mid-August, so the first-pass pack by 2027-08-03 works well. If you can surface anything that requires additional lead time, please call it out in the action plan.

Regards,
Alice Wong
Sr. Compliance Manager
Medix Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@medixhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Evidence handoff for BYOK/KMS + SSO + audit log requests

- Neha: produce Parquet 30-day sample (one scrubbed account) + SSO runbook and rotation event export — target 2027-08-03 EOD
- Priyom: KMS/keyflow diagram and short HSM vs KMS caveat paragraph — target 2027-08-03 EOD
- Evelyn: assemble evidence pack and do a pre-send review — target 2027-08-03 EOD

I will prepare a single DocuSign NDA addendum (if required) and create/update HubSpot MDX-4592 with the action items. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/r/abcd1234 (internal tracking only).

Best,

Summary of what’s included in the pack:
- Executive summary (what is BYOK here vs. HSM)
- KMS keyflow + lifecycle diagram (Priyom)
